A fractional senior operator delivers the same senior scope for $5K–$12K per month, with no junior intermediary between you and the journalist. mainEntity.name: Which UK and EU outlets can you actually get coverage in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 crypto global: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks. UK-relevant mainstream: Forbes, Bloomberg, the FT crypto desk, City A.M. and Yahoo Finance UK. EU and fintech: Sifted, EU-Startups and relevant regulatory trade press when the angle is regulatory. Coverage depends on a real news hook, not a wire blast to a press list.

mainEntity.name: How do you handle UK-specific angles like FCA registration or MiCA compliance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regulatory milestones are legitimate tier-1 news hooks when framed for the right editor at the right time. FCA registration, MiCA readiness, or a UK institutional partnership all carry credibility with British financial press that a generic announcement does not. The narrative build starts with identifying which regulatory moment is closest and what the story around it actually is.
